subject: Pilot sprint charter + weekly momentum nudges
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novara.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@novara.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot sprint charter + weekly momentum nudges

Hi Liam / Asha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed pilot (POC) sprint charter attached (pilot-charter-v1.pdf). I pulled together success criteria, a 4-week timeline, and a short ownership map so we can get to a focused kickoff. High-level summary below: 

Goal: Prove Novara's internal search + summarization flows on a subset of customer support tickets with <100ms median inference latency and >85% relevance as measured by your annotation set.

Success criteria (proposal) — must-haves to call pilot "successful":
- Functional: demo pipeline ingest -> embeddings -> retrieval -> response generation for 5k historical tickets
- Quality: relevance >= 85% on the evaluation set (Asha's 500-ticket sample)
- Performance: median inference latency <= 100ms on 8k-token config for targeted queries
- Reliability: <1% error rate during test window and KV-cache warmup included in throughput tests
- Business: 2 internal users can run the dashboard and reproduce a sample report

Timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (this week): final kickoff, network provisioning, access lists, and security questionnaire handoff
- Week 1: ingestion + baseline model run; initial eval on sample set
- Week 2: tuning (prompting, batching, cache settings) + mid-point review
- Week 3: performance run + stability testing; docs and runbook
- Week 4: wrap, acceptance demo, and handoff notes

Owners (proposal):
- Redwood integration lead: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwood.ai) — data mapping, ingestion, infra config
- Customer success / onboarding: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — kickoff logistics, acceptance criteria, internal demos
- Novara leads: Liam (engineering) and Asha (data/quality)

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Confirm stakeholders + data owner access by EOD Thursday
2) Share S3 bucket details or secure transfer method and a sample 500-row CSV by Friday
3) Fill in the attached security spreadsheet (novara-security-questions.xlsx) and mark any blockers
4) Confirm a recurring 30-min weekly check (we suggested Fridays 10am PT; open to other times)

I attached the pilot charter and the security doc stub. If this looks good I can convert the charter to a shared Drive doc and send invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting momentum.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- pilot-charter-v1.pdf (summary + tasks)
- novara-security-questions.xlsx (security questionnaire stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novara.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@novara.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sprint charter + weekly momentum nudges

Thanks Ben — this is a useful read. A few quick notes from my side after syncing with the infra team: 

- Timeline: can we slide the perf/stability week to Week 3 instead of Week 2? Our infra windows are tighter the first week. So propose: ingest/ baseline (W1), tuning (W2), perf + stability (W3), wrap (W4).
- Success criteria: we can commit to the 500-ticket eval but would prefer to define "relevance" using our internal 5-point rubric. Asha will share the rubric.
- Data delivery: we can do S3 (cross-account role) — I'll send bucket + IAM details by EOD Friday.
- Security spreadsheet: attached with a few flagged items (column "blocking" set for a couple KMS/HSM-related asks).

I attached our updated security answers (novara-security-questions.xlsx). Priya / Marissa — can you confirm whether Redwood needs an existing cross-account role or if we'll ship a temporary transfer link?

Also happy to take the Friday 10am PT weekly check — that's fine on our side.

Liam
Director of Engineering, Novara AI
liam.oconnor@novara.ai
